text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho has been Tamamo Cross's big goal for the first half of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it's not just because it's an important race, either. She has her own reasons for competing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: HERE AT LAST! After all that dreamin' and trainin', I actually pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm finally runnin' in my dad's favorite race. The only thing left to do… is win!
choice_data_list: Show them what you're made of!
Show them what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one showing her support either.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Make your family proud! We know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa there… You guys…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All you guys are… cheerin' me on. Even though there's so many other amazin' Umamusume here today…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Of course we're cheering you on! We're your fans!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're my fans… I… have fans…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I always thought the world was a cruel place. But… guess there's a whole lotta good people out there…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I think I'm gettin' chills… but I gotta focus. Time to clear my first big goal as a senior!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …You're quite the fan favorite, Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: City? Oh yeah, you're runnin' too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, I don't really get this fan stuff. I mean, I'm nowhere near as cool as you, City, so why're they cheerin' me on?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Well, it makes perfect sense to me. Fans know your roots as well, you know. It's the same as fashion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But I've got my roots as well. I don't plan on losing here, Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bring it on, City! I'll give ya a taste of all the stuff I've endured so far!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The contest Tamamo Cross's father holds so dearly is finally about to commence!
